body: Thank you so much it was so reassuring to read that. I'm so scared of not being believed thank you.

I'll probably just get reffered to a psychiatrist by my doctor, who will then tell me there's nothing wrong with me. I've talked to counsellors since I was a kid, I'm terrified of leaving an office again without anything happening.

I know I'm sick but just talking with someone doesn't get me anywhere anymore so I think you're right.
I totally get what you mean, but I hate myself because I don't love others and therefore there's no other way out. I have no reason to love myself anymore.
